label: rem:braid-twist-flip-relations
title: Relations satisfied by twist, flip and rotation
html: The twist and flip are involutions, \sigma_1^2=\sigma_2^2=\mathrm{id}. They satisfy the braid relation \sigma_1\sigma_2\sigma_1=\sigma_2\sigma_1\sigma_2 — the defining relation of the trefoil-knot group B_3 — and the rotation \alpha=\sigma_1\sigma_2 has order three, \alpha^3=\mathrm{id}: it is the cyclic permutation of the three branches, and it is the \mathrm{SU}(2) generator \alpha of the \mathrm{SU}(2) generators. The dihedral relation \sigma_1\,\alpha\,\sigma_1=\alpha^{-1} exhibits D_3\cong S_3.
